summary: Nothing is sent to your other systems from a run that did not finish every step.

fixes.title: Incomplete runs send nothing out
fixes.text: When a step that a collection is built on fails, nothing is sent to ServiceNow or the workbooks. What they have stays, and the next complete run sends what changed.

fixes.title: Restarted runs are judged correctly
fixes.text: When a run is started again from a later step, a failure earlier in that run still holds the collection back.

fixes.title: Switched-off steps never hold data back
fixes.text: A step you switched off, or a step that Risk Analysis does not read, never holds a collection back.
